contents.title: tiwa-cc.github.io
contents.summary: A portfolio site built with Flutter Web. It presents featured work, strengths, delivery approach, technical capabilities, background, and contact information in a single responsive page.
details: Structure: Shows Profile, Contents, Core Skills, About, Software Skills, Experience, and Contact in one page.
Implementation: Uses RawClient and assets/mock/*.json as a mock API, with timeout and automatic retry during the initial load.
Deployment: Published to GitHub Pages with flutter build web --wasm --base-href /.

contents.title: Workforce Manager
contents.summary: A workforce management frontend portfolio covering attendance input, logged-in user management, and a report foundation. The current scope is a frontend-first build backed by mock data.
details: Scope: Includes user information, attendance input, and a report screen backed by mock repositories.
Stack: React + Vite + TypeScript, Zustand, React Query, and shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS v4.
Quality: Adds Vitest + Testing Library, ja / en l10n, and baseline a11y with aria-live and aria-busy.

contents.title: tiwa-cc-resume-template
contents.summary: A template repository for managing resumes, skill sheets, and application documents. It separates source facts from presentation rules so target-specific variations stay manageable.
details: Purpose: Centralizes career facts and makes it easier to adjust outputs for each target.
Design: Separates data as the source of truth, templates as presentation rules, and targets as per-destination differences.
Operation: Distributed as a public template repository, then intended to be forked into a private repository for real personal data.
